title: Quiz: Text Elements
description: Check your understanding of Text Elements.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in HTML?
questions.explanation: In HTML, <!-- --> marks a comment. Block comments use -->.

questions.question: Which tag creates the largest heading?
questions.explanation: h1 is the top-level heading; numbers go down to h6.
